relevance.rationale: No text layer (Xerox scan; pdftotext, pypdf and pdfminer all return 0 chars), so read as rendered page images. It constructs a hierarchy of linking integrals whose second-order member is the Gauss/helicity integral and whose third-order member (a Massey-product integral) detects the Borromean rings, with a fourth-order member distinguishing a 4-component Brunnian entanglement from four unlinked rings, and it recasts the whole hierarchy for BRAIDS as a hierarchy of winding numbers. That last move is the reason this is core rather than supporting. The corpus's EM-linking front (bean qou-o6ml, docs/audits/2026-08-01-em-linking-reads-round1.md) is stuck on two obstructions established from the existing helicity cluster (dgkmsv, komendarczyk, khesin, cantarella-deturck-gluck): total antisymmetry of mu-bar(123), and the absence of any per-pair splitting of the Theorem-B integrand. Separately, MilnorIndeterminacyGate.lean proves that a Hopf-linked spectator collapses the mu-bar residue space to ZMod 1, i.e. the LINK invariant carries no triple content in the mixed-bond regime — which is the regime the mixed-multibond probe operates in. The third-order winding number here (eq. 22, Psi_ijk = Re integral of lambda_ij d lambda_jk + cyclic, built from the Arnol'd generators omega_ij of the braid-group cohomology) is stated as a well-defined BRAID invariant 'irrespective of whether the net second order winding numbers vanish'. The corpus's substrate is braid words in B_n, so a braid-level third-order invariant that survives nonzero pairwise winding is directly constructible here and is a different object from every invariant the EM-linking sweep has already excluded. None of this is in references.ts (no entry for this work or for the third-order-winding-number construction it cites).

keyResults.statement: The one-form psi_ijk = lambda_ij d lambda_jk + lambda_jk d lambda_ki + lambda_ki d lambda_ij is closed by the Arnol'd relation, so Psi_ijk = Re integral over gamma of psi_ijk is a homotopy-invariant third-order winding number of a 3-string braid, well defined whether or not the net second-order winding numbers vanish.
keyResults.useForFolio: A braid-level third-order invariant that is NOT killed by a Hopf-linked spectator, unlike the mu-bar residue that MilnorIndeterminacyGate.lean collapses to ZMod 1. It is the natural candidate for the mixed-multibond shared channel that the mu-bar-idempotent probe refuted, and it lives on braid words, which is what the corpus actually manipulates.

keyResults.locator: Abstract; sections on n = 3 and n = 4
keyResults.statement: A fourth-order linking integral distinguishes a 4-component Brunnian entanglement (every pair and every triple unlinked) from four unlinked rings, and the construction is sketched for general order n.
keyResults.useForFolio: An explicit A = 4 Brunnian invariant to place beside the corpus's measured A = 4 Brunnian deficit and the exact-order Milnor bridge, where the order law is currently carried as a conjecture class rather than a construction.

proposedActions.rationale: Core and orphan; the EM-linking reference cluster in references.ts has no entry for a braid-level higher-order winding number, which is the one construction its recorded obstructions do not cover.

Record, against the indeterminacy gate, that the gate's conclusion is about the LINK residue and does not apply to a braid-level third-order winding number. Deliberately NOT proposed as aid-proof: I have not checked that the corpus's closure convention and basepoint choices make Psi_ijk well defined on its braid words, nor that it is the right scale/units for a binding channel. Those two checks are what would have to happen first.

Evaluate Psi_ijk on the corpus's own Borromean braid word (sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1})^3 and on a mixed Hopf+Borromean multibond configuration, and compare with the mu-bar values the Magnus machinery already produces. This is a cross-check, not an adoption: any agreement is evidence about the construction, not a licence to wire a number.
